name: aging_biology_pack
description: Neglected aging / longevity biology unknowns with measurable operationalizations.

questions.question: Which circulating biomarkers best predict remaining healthspan under interventions that extend lifespan in model organisms?
questions.operationalization: Rank candidate biomarkers by out-of-sample AUROC ≥ 0.7 for remaining healthspan across ≥2 intervention classes in mice or equivalent, with pre-registered endpoints.
questions.why_it_matters: Longevity trials need transferable interim endpoints shorter than full lifespan.
assumptions: Healthspan endpoints can be operationalized consistently across labs.

questions.question: How much of cellular senescence burden in human tissues is causal for functional decline versus a correlated passenger of damage?
questions.operationalization: Estimate causal contribution via senolytic or genetic ablation experiments with tissue-function primary endpoints and mediation analysis of senescence markers.
questions.why_it_matters: Senolytic programs depend on whether senescence is causal or epiphenomenal in target tissues.
assumptions: Tissue-level senescence burden is measurable in vivo or ex vivo.

questions.question: Which mitochondrial quality-control interventions most improve cognitive resilience under metabolic stress without impairing basal ATP supply?
questions.operationalization: Compare interventions on a fixed metabolic-stress cognitive battery; report delta in error rates and ATP/mitochondrial flux under basal and stressed conditions.
questions.why_it_matters: Energy failure is a shared substrate of neurodegeneration and aging cognition.
assumptions: Basal ATP and stress-flux can be measured without destroying the tissue of interest.

questions.question: Which purported replications of circulating aging clocks fail under pre-registered healthspan endpoints, and what negative controls are missing?
questions.operationalization: Catalog clock studies with failed replication or null healthspan prediction (AUROC ≤ 0.55); list systematically missing negative controls across ≥10 reports.
questions.why_it_matters: Publication filters hide clock failures; ranking should prefer questions that name unresolved null gaps.
assumptions: Replication attempts or null reports can be coded from literature and registries.
